Q: How can I encode two numbers in a single Integer? A:

What you are asking is called in mathematics pairing function or Fonction de couplage in French or Paarungsfunktion in German.

There are many pairing functions, amoung which there are Goedel's, Cantor's, Chinese Remainder Theorem, etc.

Godel p.f. is not practical to encode nested languages, but it's excellent for plain languages with not so many symbols.

See also An Elegant Pairing Function by Matthew Szudzik.

Q: Is it really worth implementing toString() for entity classes A:

If your entity is jpa entity and if you want create table representation no need to write toString() method. This can make stackoverflow because if have releation between these entites they will call their toString method and will be infinite loop

Q: How to extract version of a transitive dependency into a property? A:

If you need to present a static html page (as you mentioned in your comment) with the resolved versions of your dependencies, mvn site already does this out-of-the-box for you. It will generate something called a "Dependency Report". This particular report will be generated in target/site/dependencies.html and list all your resolved dependencies sorted by scope.

Q: Making calculations in a treelike structure A:

Use reduce(). To get table B from table A:

=let(
  headers; A1:C1;
  data; filter(A2:C; len(C2:C));
  reduce(headers; sequence(rows(data)); lambda(a; i; let(
    row; index(data; i);
    get_; lambda(j; let(
      l; index(row; j);
      if(l = chooserows(tocol(choosecols(a; j); 1); -1);;l)
    ));
    vstack(a; hstack(get_(1); get_(2); get_(3)))
  )))
)

To get table C from table A:

=let(
  headers; A1:C1;
  data; filter(A2:C; len(C2:C));
  spaced; reduce(headers; sequence(rows(data)); lambda(a; i; let(
    row; index(data; i);
    get_; lambda(j; let(
      v; index(row; j);
      b; v <> chooserows(tocol(choosecols(a; j); 1); -1);
      blank; iferror(wrapcols(; j - 1;); tocol(; 1));
      vstack(blank; if(b; v;))
    ));
    ifna(vstack(a; hstack(get_(1); get_(2); get_(3))))
  )));
  filter(spaced; byrow(spaced; lambda(r; len(join(; r))))) 
)

Q: Redirect to original URL after successful authentication in Spring Security A:

For Spring Security 6.5.x and 6.4.x I have not tested on anything else

 .oauth2Login(oauth2 ->     oauth2
                    .authenticationSuccessHandler(
                            new RedirectServerAuthenticationSuccessHandler("http://localhost:9000")
                        )
                    )
